Welcome. This site collects my mathematical definitions, theorems, exercises, and proofs in a form that is searchable and easy to cross-reference.

## Pilot

The pilot converts three real items from my existing LaTeX notes:

- @def-relation from the foundations notes;
- @exr-de-morgan-union from advanced calculus; and
- @exr-double-negation from linear algebra.

Each item is presented as a focused mathematical note. Lean formalizations are deferred while the notes and exercise layout are refined.

::: {.callout-note .pilot-note}
## Pilot scope

This is intentionally a small sample. The rest of `notes-and-exercises` will not be migrated until the structure and presentation are approved.
:::
